edits.value_json: 工 is currently used for a worker, as in 木工 and 矿工. These examples support present-day usage; earlier craft-worker and skilled-maker attestations are discussed separately.

Reported early examples use 工 for status or occupation, including craft-related uses. A bronze inscription is reported to use it in an official title interpreted as 司空. The relationship between title/status and craft-worker uses is unresolved.
early oracle-bone and bronze examples; dating unresolved
